reason: My staff and I already send quotes on WhatsApp, and our rates change with raw material prices, so I don't see why I should pay Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month for something we do ourselves. The Rs 5,000 pilot is cheap, but I don't pay anyone before comparing at least three quotes, and I'm not going to go looking for two more vendors for a problem I'm not sure I have.
objection: Our pricing is not a clean list. It depends on quantity, the buyer, freight and today's raw material rate, so I doubt a system will get 7 in 10 prices right. And after the pilot it is a big setup fee plus a monthly charge that never ends.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it draft correct quotes on my own last month's enquiries for free, plus a setup fee under Rs 25,000, or a call with a trader in my line who says it brought in more orders.
